consequence.statement: Some log lines have changed format, so grep-style log filtering that matches the old format may stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Review any log filters or parsers that match cert-manager log lines.

assertion.statement: Some cert-manager log lines gained more structured logging information and changed format, which may affect tools that filter logs with grep.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Text does not say which log lines changed; whether an environment filters logs by text is not visible in configuration.
